description: This Java class 'CurrencyHelper' provides utility methods for interacting with currency-related API endpoints in the Apache Fineract project. It includes functions to retrieve permitted and selected currencies, as well as update currency options via REST API calls. The class uses the RestAssured library for HTTP requests, Gson for JSON parsing, and SLF4J for logging.

classes.name: CurrencyHelper
classes.description: A utility class to interact with currency-related API endpoints in Fineract, providing methods to get and update currencies.

methods.name: getPermittedCurrencies
methods.description: Fetches the list of permitted currencies from the API.

methods.name: getSelectedCurrencies
methods.description: Fetches the list of selected currencies from the API.

methods.name: updateCurrencies
methods.description: Updates the list of currencies via API call.
